Create an exam

The exit code is what you type on a student's machine to end their lockdown. It is stored only as a hash and is never sent to their computer, so nobody can read it off their laptop. Leave it blank and the lockdown falls back to that machine's own passcode.

Add a proctor

Creates an account and gives it proctor rights. A proctor can see every student's ID photo, face photo and screen for their own exams, so only add people who should have that.
